name: CustomsEntryWorkbench
tagline: Prepare, check and track every customs entry – HS lines, missing documents, holds, deadlines and an indicative duty estimate – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete customs entry desk for brokers, forwarders and importers: entries from pre-alert to release with HS-coded invoice lines (format and chapter checks), a document checklist driven by HS chapter, entry type and preference rules, an indicative customs value (CIF / FOB basis, freight, insurance, exchange rate), duty by HS prefix, processing fee, VAT / GST and de minimis, filing deadlines, licensed-broker filing, customs holds and exams, release, payments and closing. Dashboard, entries list, broker board, document matrix and duty by chapter with a tariff calculator. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: HS-coded invoice lines with format / chapter checks and per-line rates
Document checklist by HS chapter, entry type, mode and preference
Indicative customs value: CIF / FOB basis, freight, insurance, exchange rate
Duty by HS prefix, processing fee with min / max, VAT / GST, de minimis
Suspended / deferred duty for temporary, warehouse and transit entries
Filing deadlines with due / overdue flags
Licensed-broker filing, amend / withdraw and reopen
Customs holds (exam, X-ray, agency, valuation, classification) blocking release
Release, payments and balance; close rules
Act today list, ActionListJson and SummaryJson for flows
Bulk request documents, mark ready, file, assign, close + undo
Keyboard and phone layout with bottom bar
Demo mode with fictional sample data
